search.query: The plan denied the denied service (CO-16 missing info). Find the plan language that supports covering it on appeal (emergency services, medical necessity, prior authorization), quoting each clause verbatim with its section and page, and the facts in the medical record that support the service.

clauses.quote: Emergency services are covered at the in-network cost-sharing level when No Surprises Act protections apply.
clauses.why_it_helps: The only coverage-supporting clause in the plan document, but it is conditional on the service being an emergency and on No Surprises Act protections applying. The denied service 80048 (basic metabolic blood panel) was billed as a routine office-visit lab (POS 11, 2026-10-15), not an emergency, so this clause does not actually support covering it. No 'medical necessity' or 'prior authorization' clause appears anywhere in the plan document.

clauses.quote: This summary is not a guarantee of payment; the plan document controls.
clauses.why_it_helps: Works against coverage on appeal: the summary of benefits is the only plan material in scope, and it defers to a full plan document (the denial cites 'Synthetic plan section 9') that is not present in the workspace, so no controlling medical-necessity or prior-authorization language can be quoted.

letter.subject: Request for an itemized bill for account AC-DEMO-07

clauses.title: Opening a records request
clauses.text: I am writing to Cedar Vale Clinic about account AC-DEMO-07. Please send an itemized bill and the records that support the charges before the balance is treated as due. I am not agreeing to the amount billed. Please reply by 2027-03-01.

clauses.title: Missing or insufficient documentation
clauses.text: The documents on file are not enough to support line 3, 80048 (Basic metabolic blood panel) for $0.00. Please send the missing record or correct the line. This letter is not an agreement that the charge is owed.

clauses.title: Itemized bill and records
clauses.text: Please send, for account AC-DEMO-07 with Cedar Vale Clinic, an itemized bill that lists each code, description, date of service, units, and charge. Please also send the orders or notes that support the services on that bill. I need those records before I can review the balance. Please reply by 2027-03-01.

clauses.title: Hold collections
clauses.text: Please hold collections, late fees, and credit reporting on account AC-DEMO-07 while you review this letter. The amount in dispute is $0.00. Please confirm the hold in writing before 2027-03-01.

clauses.title: Closing and signature
clauses.text:
Please reply in writing by 2027-03-01 with a corrected statement or a decision.
Member id on file: SYN-DEMO-07.
